compute_maximum_product_horizontal: compute the maximum product of 4 adjacent elements horizontally in a matrix
compute_maximum_product_vertical: compute the maximum product of 4 adjacent elements vertically in a matrix
compute_maximum_product_diagonal: compute the maximum product of 4 adjacent elements diagonally in a matrix
run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum product of 4 adjacent elements in any direction
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple matrix inputs and compare results with expected outputs
